text:
I got out of the way
so as not to be a nuisance,
so as not to cry out
any more plaintive verses.

I spent many days without writing,
without seeing you,
eating nothing but tears.

translation.title: Sentimental Self-Euthanasia

Direct translation; no separate editorial review was conducted.
